cues: The metre bridge is a Wheatstone bridge built from one uniform wire, exactly a metre long, stretched along a scale.
The unknown resistance X goes in the left gap, a known resistance R in the right gap.
The two parts of the wire, either side of a sliding jockey, act as the other two arms.
text: The metre bridge is a Wheatstone bridge built from one uniform wire, exactly a metre long, stretched along a scale. The unknown resistance X goes in the left gap, a known resistance R in the right gap. The two parts of the wire, either side of a sliding jockey, act as the other two arms.
